entities.name: Nekusar
entities.description: Legendary zombie wizard, a former king from an unknown plane who became a lich lord after being killed in his throne room.

events.summary: One of Nekusar's plots to assassinate a rival backfires and he is killed in his throne room.
events.quote: When one of his many plots to assassinate a rival backfired, Nekusar was killed in his throne room

events.summary: Nekusar, having prepared for death, transforms himself into a lich lord.
events.quote: he transformed himself into a lich lord

events.summary: Nekusar positions himself as the secret power of the realm, watching the court through informants.
events.quote: Nekusar has positioned himself as the secret power of the realm
